name: wp-chosen
description: Makes unwieldy select boxes more user-friendly

scripts.build:check: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- wp-chosen/assets/css/wp-chosen.css wp-chosen/assets/css/wp-chosen.css.map
scripts.dev: postcss wp-chosen/assets/css/scss/wp-chosen.scss --output wp-chosen/assets/css/wp-chosen.css --env dev --config wp-chosen/assets/css/postcss-configs/main && prettier wp-chosen/assets/css/wp-chosen.css --write
